manifest.name: Skills Management
manifest.summary: Manage skills, knowledge and resume of your employees

behavioral_notes.observation: Employee/job skills are append-only versioned, not edited in place. hr.employee.create/write route every command through hr.employee.skill._get_transformed_commands, which rewrites WRITE into archive (set valid_to=yesterday) + CREATE of a new record, so the full history of skill levels over time is preserved via valid_from/valid_to windows. Records younger than 24h or already expired are deleted instead of archived. None of this is visible in metadata.

@api.constrains enforces only one active level per (employee/job, skill_id) for regular skills (e.g. one English level at a time), while certifications (is_certification=True) may coexist if their valid_from/valid_to ranges differ. hr.job.skill overrides _can_edit_certification_validity_period to False; hr.employee.skill leaves it True, which relaxes the overlap rule for editable certification validity.

A skill type must contain at least one skill and one level (_check_no_null_skill_or_skill_level ValidationError). Levels carry level_progress (0-100, DB CHECK constraint) and a single default_level enforced across siblings on create/write. hr.skill.level.technical_is_new_default is a non-stored compute set only by the OWL front-end so the type onchange knows which level just became default.

Scheduled action scans employees whose hr.job requires certification skills and schedules a mail.activity (act_type hr_skills.mail_activity_data_upload_certification) to the responsible user when a required certification is missing or expiring within 3 months (reads hr.employee.skill.valid_to). Pure cross-model side-effect, invisible in metadata.

SQL view, not a stored table. init() builds a point-in-time timeline by cross-joining each skill's valid_from/valid_to window against the set of change dates, so a graph of skill level over time can be drawn; the skills OWL widget opens it via doAction. hr.employee.skill.report and hr.employee.certification.report inherit hr.manager.department.report for department/manager roll-ups.

11 JS files, 8 XML templates, 2 OWL components (FormattedDate, InternalResumeLineComponent); 8 registry adds incl fields skills_one2many/resume_one2many/many2{one,many}_tags_skills, view_widget internal_resume_lines and a skills_graph view; 1 patch (AvatarCardResourcePopover). skills_one2many (SkillsX2ManyField) gates a timeline/report button on HR-user-or-subordinate; internal_resume_lines calls hr.employee.get_internal_resume_lines to render job-title history derived from employee version_ids. Bundles ['web.assets_backend','web.assets_backend_lazy','web.assets_unit_tests','web.assets_tests','web.report_assets_pdf'].

it_architecture.application: hr_skills (Skills Management application component, auto-installed on hr)
information_flows: side-effect: hr.employee.write(skills) -> _get_transformed_commands -> archive old hr.employee.skill + create new (versioned history)
side-effect: cron _add_certification_activity_to_employees -> mail.activity reminders for missing/expiring certifications
side-effect: skills OWL widget -> hr.employee.skill.history.report (SQL view) graph

value_streams: Competency lifecycle: define skill type/levels -> assign employee skill -> version on change (archive+create) -> expire/renew certification -> report skill-over-time
organization: hr.group_hr_user (HR Officer: full CRUD on skills/types/levels)
base.group_user (Employee: read all, self-service on own skills)
policies: 11 record rules scoping skill/resume visibility (own vs HR)
constraint: one active level per (employee, skill); certifications coexist by validity range
constraint: skill type requires >=1 skill and >=1 level; level_progress CHECK 0-100
automation: certification missing/expiring activity reminder (cron, 3-month horizon)

classification.rationale: hr_skills is an HR talent/competency management support activity: it does not transact with customers or move product, it maintains the firm's human-capital data (skills, levels, certifications, resumes) that primary activities draw on. As a support infrastructure module it auto_installs on hr and serves HR/manager roles. Maps to APQC 7.0 Develop and Manage Human Capital (7.3 Manage employee development / competencies). No HR row exists in apqc_odoo_map.tsv (which only covers chain/shop primary flows), consistent with this being a support subsystem.

standard_capabilities: skill types with ordered levels and progress %
employee resume lines + printable CV (PDF via /print/cv)
typical_fits: certification expiry tracking with activity reminders
manager roll-up of team skills by department/job
common_gaps: weighting/scoring employee skills against job requirements (gap analysis)
integration of external LMS / appraisal data into resume lines
custom certification renewal SLAs beyond the 3-month cron horizon
drive_hints: curl http://localhost:8069/print/cv (auth=user) to render the employee CV PDF report

open_questions: There is no dedicated hr.employee.skill.log model; skill history is reconstructed from valid_from/valid_to windows and the hr.employee.skill.history.report SQL view -- confirm no separate audit-log model is expected.
Exact set of 11 record rules and which scope own-vs-HR visibility (only counts captured by extraction).
How resume job-title history derives from hr.employee.version_ids (get_internal_resume_lines) interacts with hr_contract/employee-versioning modules.
